name: Bánréve (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Bánréve: a crowned shield of white and green with a yellow lion and a stag, with red and blue mantling and a green scroll inscribed BÁNRÉVE.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Bánréve arms with crown, mantling and scroll
